control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for G-8102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on G-8102 and TT-8102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. G-8102 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during routine operation while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 18 October 2020 a planned critical control verification of G-8102 and TT-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks not effective.
